Special Account — Edit

The Special Account form enables you to create custom subsidiary ledgers for tracking unique financial relationships or obligations that don't fit into standard accounting categories.

Special accounts provide flexibility to track items such as loans (given or received), customer deposits, escrow accounts, project funds, or any other financial position requiring separate monitoring. Each special account maintains its own balance and transaction history, appearing as a line item within its designated control account on the balance sheet.

When creating a special account, choose a meaningful code and name that clearly identifies its purpose. Select the appropriate control account to determine where it appears on your balance sheet. You can also assign divisions for segmented reporting and set a specific currency if dealing with foreign currency positions. Special accounts are particularly useful for businesses needing to track multiple loans, project-specific funds, or customer retainers separately.

This form contains the following fields:

Name

Enter the name of the special account. This should clearly identify what the account tracks, such as 'Loan from Bank ABC' or 'Prepaid Insurance'.

Code

Optionally, enter a code for this special account. Codes help organize and quickly identify special accounts in lists and reports.

Currency

Assign a foreign currency if this special account tracks balances in a currency other than your base currency.

Note: This option appears only if foreign currencies are created in the system.

Tax Code

Select a default tax code for transactions involving this special account. This can be overridden on individual transactions.

Division

Assign this special account to a specific division if you use divisional accounting. This helps track special account balances by division.

Control account

Select a control account if you want this special account to post to a different balance sheet account than the default special accounts control.

Inactive

Mark this special account as inactive to hide it from dropdown lists while preserving historical transactions. Useful for closed or discontinued special accounts.
